CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   B. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   D. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   D. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Black, white, and grey

4. Best practice when working on Football: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Football with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume

8. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)

9. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.

   C. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   D. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Dance.

11. Best practice when working on Painting and Mosaic: (1 mark)

12. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

13. Best practice when working on Wind Musical Instruments: (1 mark)

   B. Disrupt classmates during Wind Musical Instruments.
   C. Practise Wind Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

14. Best practice when working on Rounders: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rounders with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Rounders.

15. Best practice when working on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts : (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
